subject: POC Maestro: Mutual Action Plan & Environment close cadence
messages:
From: Elena Petrova <elena@medworks.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Ian Brooks <ian@bluebeacon.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC requirements & timing — MedWorks POC MAP

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to formalize a short MAP so we can get the POC environment live quickly — target window is ~2–3 weeks if possible. High level asks from our side: org setup and admin access, API key provisioning, IP allowlist for our outbound services, and VPC peering to our test VPC.

Can you share a brief mutual action plan with milestone dates and a checklist of the exact artifacts your infra team will need from us (CIDR blocks, service account owner, contact for peering setup)? We have a networking blackout window next Friday so ideally peering should be scheduled before that.

If you can also include the validation steps we should run once keys/peering are in place that would help shorten validation.

Thanks — cc'ing Ian (network lead) for the peering specifics.

Elena Petrova
Director of Platform, MedWorks AI
elena@medworks.ai
+1 415 555 0192

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@medworks.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, Ian Brooks <ian@bluebeacon.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC requirements & timing — MedWorks POC MAP

Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the timeline constraint. I've put together an initial MAP draft (attached) with milestones tailored to your request. Key immediate asks below so we can lock the peering window and get API keys stood up: 

- Confirm the peering contact and preferred maintenance window (we can be flexible but need at least a 2-hour window).
- Provide your peering CIDR(s) and the IP ranges you want allowlisted for API traffic.
- Confirm the account owner (email) for org creation + who will accept the invite.
- Let us know if KMS integration (customer-managed keys) is required for the POC; otherwise we'll use platform-managed keys for speed.

Quick timeline from our side (draft):
1) Aug 22 — Org + service account created; initial API keys issued to account owner (temp keys).
2) Aug 23 — Networking: IP allowlist applied; VPC peering scheduled and executed.
3) Aug 24–25 — Validation: smoke tests and sample traffic run by MedWorks; we observe and tune.
4) Aug 26 — Final sign-off and transition to trial monitoring.

I'll route the MAP draft to our tech team and loop in priyom for the exact network steps. Attached: POC-MAP-draft-20260821.pdf.

If the blackout window you mentioned is next Friday (Aug 28), let's aim to have peering completed by Aug 23 so you have at least one day before blackout.

Cheers,

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@medworks.ai>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Ian Brooks <ian@bluebeacon.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC requirements & timing — MedWorks POC MAP

Elena / Soojin — quick technical breakdown to make the MAP actionable. Below are the exact items our infra team will do and the items we need from MedWorks: 

Redwood deliverables (what we'll do):
- Create a MedWorks org under Redwood Private (POC sandbox) and invite the designated account owner.
- Generate scoped API keys (short-lived by default, 30d); we can issue long-lived trial keys on request. Keys are delivered to the account owner via secure link.
- Configure token-level logging and a temporary audit retention for the POC period.
- Work with networking to accept your VPC peering and announce the Redwood peering route to your CIDR.

MedWorks inputs required (please provide as early as possible):
- Peering CIDR(s) and the BGP ASN if applicable (or indicate static routes).
- Public egress IP range(s) to allowlist for API traffic (if you proxy through NAT, list the NAT IPs).
- Point-of-contact for peering and a calendar availability block for the maintenance window.
- Contact email for org admin (who will accept the invite).

Technical notes and constraints:
- VPC peering: we support classic peering and shared VPC attachments. For quick setup choose classic peering; if you need cross-project shared VPC we will coordinate but that adds ~1 day.
- MTU and security group recommendations included in the attached network-peering-diagram.png.
- API key rotation: we'll provide a redwood-api-key-setup.md guide which includes curl examples, client SDK settings (timeout 60s), and sample rate limits to start with.

Target: if we receive the CIDR + POC admin by EOD Aug 22, we can issue keys Aug 22 and schedule peering for Aug 23. Otherwise the plan shifts by 48–72 hours.

- Priyom
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@medworks.ai>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC requirements & timing — MedWorks POC MAP

Elena — appreciate the urgency and the clear asks. Confirming the MAP and proposing a firm close cadence so we can sign off on the POC by the end of next week: 

Finalized cadence proposal (please confirm):
- By Aug 22 EOD: MedWorks supplies CIDR, peering POC contact, and account owner email.
- Aug 23 AM: Redwood issues API keys and applies provisional IP allowlist for testing.
- Aug 23 afternoon: VPC peering maintenance window (2 hours) — networking teams coordinate.
- Aug 24–25: Joint validation window. We'll run the validation checklist from our MAP and share results by EOD Aug 25.
- Aug 26: Final sign-off / POC acceptance or list of follow-up items.

Fallback: if peering slips beyond Aug 23 we'll perform an expedited hosted fallback so MedWorks can validate through a secure tunnel; that will preserve the Aug 24–25 validation window but requires temporary credentials.

Please reply "ACK" on the timeline above and drop the CIDR + peering contact inline. Once we have that I'll schedule the peering slot and finalize the MAP PDF (attached earlier).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
